name: Spiralkey Dragon - Young
description: Young Spiralkey is a neutral-leaning firmament intelligent true dragon with a floating wingless body traced with golden spirals. It seeks to find sealed paths and challenge those who force passage. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Spiral Horns
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Floating
abilities.description: The dragon floats over ground hazards and ignores difficult ground.

abilities.name: Threshold Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 16. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and the dragon moves the target to an unoccupied visible place within Close range. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
